title: Data360: the World Bank's indicators, searched by meaning and read by economy
format: Asked on demand by data/acquisition/services.py and kept in data/cache/data360/. The same service data360-mcp offers to language models; the workbench asks it directly.
coverage: The databases Data360 holds, among them the World Development Indicators.
licence: As each database states; the World Development Indicators are CC BY 4.0.
